description:
Play a recorded action from the Actions palette.

Names are the ones the Actions panel shows, in the Photoshop UI language: the built-in set is "Default Actions" only in English Photoshop. When the set or the action does not exist, the error (code invalid_arguments) lists the names this Photoshop has; retry with one of them.

actionName.description: Name of the action to play, exactly as the Actions panel shows it

actionSetName.description: Name of the action set containing the action, exactly as the Actions panel shows it (localized for the sets Photoshop ships)

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool activates that document before running so a UI tab switch cannot retarget the edit.

name: photoshop_play_action
